reply_text:
Your first report was at **10:42 AM on 3 Aug** (15:42 UTC), when you posted that the gate kiosks were offline at Vantorre's Hartford plant. Both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan.

The channel has only one note on the guard, in that same 10:42 message: the guard was "writing trailer numbers on a clipboard." Nothing else in the channel describes the guard between 10:42 and the lanes coming back. The closest later entry is Mateo's 11:03 AM message that kiosk 1 was back and the guard had checked in trailer 8836. If the postmortem needs the guard's activity over that window, that will have to come from the site or from Vantorre directly.
